title: Dashboard Lighthouse: Mini-mentor Snippets for Home Console
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Ship a lightweight "mini-mentor" system: contextual, card-sized guided snippets anchored to primary dashboard panels (Cost Overview, Rollouts, Model Health). Each snippet introduces one micro-action (e.g., pinning a route, toggling auto-rollout, connecting billing alerts) in 2–3 steps with inline CTA and a 'Try it' sandbox mode. Snippets must be non-modal, dismissible, persist state per user workspace, and tracked for analytics. Goal: reduce time-to-first-action and surface cost-saving levers without overwhelming the home experience.
acceptance_criteria: Three snippet types implemented as clickable inline cards on Cost, Rollouts, and Model Health widgets
Each snippet includes headline, 2-step microflow, lightweight animation, and a single CTA that performs the action or opens a focused panel
Dismissible with 'Don't show again' persisted to user settings; user can re-open via Help > Mini-mentors
Telemetry events emitted for impressions, clicks, completions, dismissals (schema reviewed with Analytics)
Accessibility: keyboard focusable, screen-reader readable labels, meets WCAG 2.1 AA for contrast and focus order
Performance: initial load impact under 40ms for additional DOM and under 10KB of CSS/JS per snippet variant
design_notes: Prefer inline microcards anchored to the widget header vs tooltips to preserve spatial context
Use soft motion: subtle transform + opacity for entrance; avoid blocking overlays
Design should adapt to collapsed/expanded widget states and responsive breakpoints (>=320px)
Prioritize cost snippet variants: 'Quick estimate', 'Set budget alert', 'Apply cache policy' as CTAs
Create a compact variant for high-density dashboards where space is constrained
assets: SVG icon set for micromentors (bulb, shield, lightning)
review_feedback: PM (Nora, 2026-03-01): Favor inline cards; recommend emphasis on conversion metric (set budget alert) as primary KPI

UXR (Diego, 2026-03-05): Early usability test (n=8) — users liked non-modal flows but wanted explicit 'what changed' microcopy after CTA
Accessibility (Rachel, 2026-03-06): Ensure aria-expanded semantics and focus return after 'Try it' sandbox close
Design Review (Marco, 2026-03-10): Fine-tune copy, reduce headline length to 36 characters max for mobile
decisions: Implement inline microcards (not tooltips/modal) to preserve dashboard context — agreed 2026-03-03
Persist dismissals per workspace and offer global re-enable in Help menu — agreed 2026-03-04
Lazy-load SVG sprites and motion JSON after first contentful paint to meet perf target — agreed 2026-03-03
Telemetry schema will reuse existing analytic.category='mini_mentor' and include fields: snippet_id, variant, action, result — agreed 2026-03-07
